lyrics:
[Intro: plain piano chords, soft pedal steel]

[Verse 1: warm female alto, close]
Onions burning, radio low
Your shirt's on inside out
Our girl is laughing at her phone
Nobody's in a hurry, nobody's left the house

[Pre-Chorus: drums enter softly]
There's nothing here to photograph
That's how I know

[Chorus: full band, voice opening wide]
Keep this one
When the rest go soft and gray
The steam, the light, the way you turn around
Don't anybody move today
If I only get to carry one thing out
Keep this one

[Verse 2: voice fuller, guitar answering]
She'll be gone in two more summers
You'll be grayer, so will I
The dog won't make it to her wedding
And this window won't face this sky

[Pre-Chorus: drums build]
I'm not sad. I'm paying attention.
That's all it is

[Chorus: full band, voice opening wide]
Keep this one
When the rest go soft and gray
The steam, the light, the way you turn around
Don't anybody move today
If I only get to carry one thing out
Keep this one

[Bridge: piano and voice, breaking on the high note]
I've lost the big days, lost whole years
I couldn't tell you what I wore
But I will have this till I'm ash
You, a wooden spoon, a kitchen floor

[Final Chorus: biggest, held last note]
Keep this one
When the rest go soft and gray
The steam, the light, the way you turn around
Don't anybody move today
If I only get to carry one thing out
Keep this one

[Outro: piano, a smoke alarm chirps, everybody laughs]
